title: Cannon component: aim envelope ±65/-30..+45, servo, cadence, muzzle trace, heat per P-01
acceptance: Shots never pass through frame (obstruction check)
description: Scaffold: UCannonComponent has the heat model; wire aim/servo and traces.

result.summary: Cannon component finished. Each cannon owns its aim, cadence and heat. Aim envelope (+/-65 yaw, -30..+45 pitch) and servo are a pure model (Weapons/CannonAimModel.h) with IsAimClamped for the HUD. Fixed a scaffold bug: traces ignored the whole rig, so shots passed through the frame; now only the cannon's own barrel parts are ignored, and a shot is blocked by the frame, the other cannon, or anything between barrel root and muzzle. Added FCannonShot result (hit, blocked, weak point, damage), OnOverheatChanged, OnVentingChanged, GetBarrelImpactPoint for the aim marker, ResetHeat.
result.verification: Built ETMEditor Win64 Development on UE 5.8.4, zero errors and warnings. 5 new automation tests (ETM.Weapons.Cannon.*) pass in a headless editor, using a real test world with collision boxes: independent cannons, 12 shots to lock, no vent during lock, multipliers x1/x2/x0.25/x0, 60 m range, frame and wall obstruction. No headset, no rig mesh, no real enemies.
result.remaining: OnFired signature changed to a single FCannonShot parameter (nothing else bound to it yet). Per-surface multiplier overrides (Bulwark shield x0.1) are left to the enemy base, T-0013. Rig frame collision must exist and block the Visibility channel for the obstruction rule to work in the real rig (T-0008). Servo speed 360 deg/s is a prototype value. Heat parity automation test is T-0010. Branch agent/claude-code-dartonx-pc/t-0009 needs a PR into main.
result.next: Review T-0009. Ready now: T-0012 (input mapping), T-0013 (enemy base), T-0018 (objective). After T-0009 is approved: T-0010, T-0015, T-0019.
